summary: Reconciled the stale-frontier EFF016B recovery after another worker had already landed the four-alias transport-denial normalization in commit e332069b1bd56d8aadb1d3acf019df49adcb7de1. Fresh verification proved classification-only and nested transport-boundary denials remain telemetry but are excluded from actionable GUIDE_RESCATE evidence. The split allocator refactor had broken the global static ratchet because it inspected only the wrapper source; this worker repaired the ratchet to treat wrapper plus core-v3 as one logical allocator source, bound the EFF016B workflow to wrapper/core/checker changes, and bound Live Feed rebuilds to core-v3 changes. The dedicated EFF016B workflow then passed on canonical main. A fresh allocator compile reported blocked_ref_in_actionable_evidence=false. Separate Live/Efficiency failures observed after the watcher update concern PROJECT_FRONTIER_THIN and unified batch sharding invariants and are not promoted as EFF016B failures.
